# Findings register

One file per empirical claim; the files point to the evidence (STATUS entries, backlog items, results), they
do not replace it. Kept by the lead agent; other agents report findings and never edit this folder.
Query: `node findings/findings.mjs find '{"topic":"packing","status":{"$in":["established","indicated"]}}'`
(MongoDB query syntax via sift; see the script header), or `list --topic t --status s --grep text`.

| status | meaning | n |
|---|---|---|
| established | a pre-registered reading, read mechanically against its rule | 19 |
| indicated | descriptive, post hoc, exploratory or measured without a prior rule | 27 |
| literature | reported by a cleared source; not tested here | 8 |
| hypothesis | our reasoning; untested | 3 |
| closed | a tested line with no further arms (a negative result) | 6 |
| superseded | replaced by a later finding (superseded_by) | 1 |

| id | status | finding | date |
|---|---|---|---|

## Per-ant activity and persistence

| id | status | finding | date |
|---|---|---|---|
| [F002](F002-c1-persistence-collapse.md) | indicated | C1 bought the colony-average rows with per-ant persistence: nurse 6-h lag correlation 0.09 vs data 0.43 | 2026-10-16 |
| [F006](F006-latent-state-variability.md) | established | A slowly varying per-ant walk-on state (SD 1, τ 60 s) improves nurse T2 and short-still rows at matched activity | 2026-10-17 |
| [F007](F007-constant-rate-no-t2.md) | established | A higher constant walk-on rate alone gives no T2 gain and worsens stillness | 2026-10-17 |
| [F008](F008-walkon-trait-sigma.md) | indicated | A fixed lognormal per-ant walk-on trait with σ 0.4 matches per-ant persistence at the start point; σ 0.7 overshoots | 2026-10-16 |
| [F009](F009-no-refractory-signature.md) | indicated | No refractory signature: the hazard of a movement onset falls with time since the last run, more steeply in the data | 2026-10-17 |
| [F057](F057-lognormal-activity-lenoir.md) | literature | L. niger total activity per ant is lognormal (≈ 500-fold range) and nurses are the most immobile | 2026-10-16 |

## Packing, walls and resting sites

| id | status | finding | date |
|---|---|---|---|
| [F027](F027-model-less-packed.md) | established | The model is less packed than the data: near share 0.80 vs 0.96, with typical neighbour distance matched | 2026-10-17 |
| [F028](F028-occupancy-site-vs-walls.md) | indicated | The data's ants sit at a colony-specific site; the model's at the walls and corners | 2026-10-17 |
| [F029](F029-stop-rate-aggregation-freezes.md) | closed | Aggregation by multiplying stop rates with resting neighbours reaches the near share only by nearly freezing the colony | 2026-10-17 |
| [F030](F030-site-alone-not-packing.md) | indicated | A data-fed site alone puts ants in the right place without the data's packing: location is not packing | 2026-10-17 |
| [F031](F031-taxis-overcompacts.md) | closed | Taxis toward resting nestmates over-compacts (median NN ≈ 0.4 × the data's) and fails the guards | 2026-10-18 |
| [F032](F032-specular-wall-rule.md) | established | Specular wall reflection passes the data-anchored guard and removes most of the wall excess (band 0.52 → 0.11) | 2026-10-17 |
| [F033](F033-baseline-exits-activity-off.md) | indicated | The baseline model exits the nest 1.7–1.8× as often as the data and has no light/dark activity contrast | 2026-10-17 |
| [F050](F050-marking-sets-site.md) | literature | In L. niger, ground marking sets where a cluster forms and how fast, not how many aggregate | 2026-10-18 |
| [F051](F051-missing-site-root-cause.md) | hypothesis | Missing nest structure (brood or resting site, a fixed queen, body exclusion) may be one root of the packing, co-movement and brief-stop failures | 2026-10-18 |
| [F052](F052-neighbour-rest-amplification.md) | literature | Rest length grows with the number of neighbours (L. niger brood-tenders: leaving rate a·A^−b) | 2026-10-18 |
| [F053](F053-red-light-foragers.md) | literature | L. niger foragers aggregate poorly under red light but like brood-tenders in darkness (≈ 80 %) | 2026-10-18 |
| [F055](F055-jeanson-mixture.md) | literature | Rest durations can be a short/long mixture whose mix depends on neighbours, and moving animals can set resting ones moving (cockroaches) | 2026-10-18 |
| [F060](F060-the-data-s-resting-region-is-broad-half.md) | indicated | The data's resting region is broad (half-mass radius ≈ 12 mm), colony-specific and fixed over 24 h and light/dark; the queen lies inside it, not at its centre | 2026-10-19 |
| [F061](F061-in-the-data-neighbours-and-the-site.md) | indicated | In the data, neighbours and the site retain resting ants independently: leaving falls with neighbours (b ≈ 1.07, saturating, mostly by longer rests) and stopping rises with them; bodies keep ≈ 1.5 mm apart with a shell at 2.4 mm | 2026-10-19 |
| [F062](F062-no-taxis-toward-resting-neighbours.md) | indicated | No taxis toward resting neighbours (moving ants turn slightly away) and no collision-triggered departures once rest age is stratified; site-directed turning is weak | 2026-10-19 |
| [F063](F063-resting-ants-avoid-the-walls-still-steps.md) | indicated | Resting ants avoid the walls: still steps within 3 mm of the walls are 0.18 [0.10, 0.27] of the area share (the model's wall band ≈ 2.45) | 2026-10-19 |

| id | status | finding | date |
|---|---|---|---|
| [F034](F034-light-dark-contrasts.md) | indicated | The data differ between phases (activity ×1.37, moving contacts ×1.5, trip median ×2.4 longer in dark); the model has no phase dependence | 2026-10-18 |
